Good morning weekend crew,
Seating plans came up before opening, so just a quick note

Please keep the focus on calm handoffs and clear updates for every traveler with a pet. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and that means we should slow the pace a bit if a crate check, document check, or carrier fit needs another look. The welcome team is doing a solid job setting people up for boarding, so let us match that with steady guidance and a friendly tone at the counter.

For the Thornwick cases, <<FACT F016>> make sure that information stays in the right workflow and do not repeat it in open chat. If a guest is stressed, keep the language simple and reassuring, then steer them toward the next step without adding extra detail. For Port Isolde, <<FACT F021>> and keep that info inside the proper file as well. We want each passenger to feel looked after, and that starts with us giving the same clear answer every time, whether they are traveling with Ranger or another companion animal.

Aurelia Skyways depends on this desk to keep companion travel dependable, so let us protect the process, stay patient, and avoid shortcuts that could create confusion later. If anything feels off, flag it early and hand it to the senior coordinator before it becomes a boarding problem.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
